# SSO API

13 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/sso-providers`

List SSO providers

List all SSO providers (admin only)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of SSO providers | `application/json`: array of [SSOProvider](schemas.md#ssoprovider) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/sso-providers`

Create SSO provider

Create a new SSO provider (admin only)

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object | no | - |
| `display_name` | string | yes | - |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | - |
| `kind` | string | yes | One of: `oidc`, `saml`. |
| `slug` | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | SSO provider created | `application/json`: [SSOProvider](schemas.md#ssoprovider) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `POST /api/v1/auth/sso/oidc/{slug}/logout`

OIDC logout

Ends the local session (the request body is ignored; same-origin only). When the session was created by this provider and its IdP advertises an end_session_endpoint, responds 200 with the RP-initiated logout URL the browser must navigate to; otherwise 204.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `slug` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Logged out locally; continue at the IdP | `application/json`: [EndSessionResponse](schemas.md#endsessionresponse) |
| `204` | Logged out locally, no IdP logout | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/auth/sso/providers`

List SSO providers

List available SSO providers (public)

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of SSO providers | `application/json`: array of object |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `[].display_name` | string | no | - |
| `[].kind` | string | no | One of: `oidc`, `saml`. |
| `[].slug` | string | no | - |
